workstream: P5 / AC1018-AC1021 TABLE row alignment parser and DXF mapping

dwg.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

mask.0x004000: title row alignment BS, DXF group 170
mask.0x008000: header row alignment BS, DXF group 170
mask.0x010000: data row alignment BS, DXF group 170

dxf.field: Group 170 is cell alignment and may repeat once per cell type at the table entity level.
dxf.limit: The reference does not state the order of repeated cell-type values. The title/header/data assignment follows the ODA table-level fields and remains a bounded inference pending a physical producer witness.

implementation.behavior: The DXF parser retains table-level group-170 values according to selected 0x4000/0x8000/0x10000 flags, without conflating cell-level group 170. Missing, excess, or out-of-domain (outside 1..9) table values leave the record readable but semantically incomplete. The writer emits selected values in title/header/data order and refuses unselected orphan values, invalid enums, and other unmodeled TABLE overrides.
implementation.generatedControl: Locally authored AC1021 ASCII and Binary DXF inputs verify all three table-level values, a separate cell-level group-170 value, and missing/excess/invalid-value incomplete behavior.
implementation.outputControl: Generated TABLE exports verify exact group-170 sequence [cell-level 4, title 2, header 5, data 8], both ASCII and Binary parse-back, destination preservation for unmapped metadata, and corrected same-writer retry.

validation.tableRegressionControls: PASS: libdxfrw_table_content_dxf_projection, libdxfrw_table_legacy_override_177, libdxfrw_table_legacy_text_height, and libdxfrw_table_legacy_merge, 4/4
validation.fixtures: No fixture files added; controls generate inputs from scratch.

limits: Generated codec and round-trip evidence only; no physical DXF producer witness or native precedence/rendering qualification.
The Autodesk DXF reference does not state the order for repeated entity-level group-170 entries; this mapping uses ODA's title/header/data order as a bounded inference.
Row heights, row text-style handles, row colors/fills and all border table-level values remain output-refused.
This does not qualify producer-wide TABLE support or whole-drawing conversion.
next: Map row fill-none and text/fill colors only for CMC methods with exact reversible DXF representation; retain refusal for unsupported methods and continue seeking a physical TABLE DXF ordering witness.
